what_it_does: VGC (Versatile GPU Compression) compresses scientific simulation data on graphics processors to reduce storage and I/O bottlenecks. The framework supports three different compression algorithms, all aware of data dimensionality (2D, 3D, 4D arrays). It offers two modes: memory-efficient compression for full-array processing, and selective decompression for on-demand data access. The GPUs can compress data as fast as simulations generate it.
